Camron Harris of Henrico, Virginia, was found hiding in a closet inside Seward Hall at approximately 4 p.m., more than 14 hours after the shooting erupted near university residence halls early Saturday morning, according to the Associated Press. Harris is not a student at Virginia State University. Camron Harris (Chesterfield County Police via AP) Police obtained eight felony warrants for Harris: four counts of malicious wounding and four counts of using a firearm in the commission of a felony. He was taken to the Chesterfield County Jail and is being held without bond. Authorities said additional charges may be filed, according to WTVR. The shooting occurred at approximately 1:28 a.m. Saturday near the university’s residence halls. Officers responding to the scene found five people suffering from gunshot wounds.
